videos.headline: Noah Fifita leads Isaiah Mizell to the end zone for Arizona
Jaden Craig puts TCU on the board with a TD
TCU's Hudson Hooper takes a pick-six 93 yards to the house
Arizona's Tre Smith blocks TCU's 50-yard field goal attempt
Noah Fifita finds the end zone for 9-yard TD
Jaden Craig keeps it for his second rushing TD for TCU
Quincy Craig holds on to make a tough TD catch for Arizona
